rows.title: Neuberger Specialty Finance (NBSF) $700 million facility to finance power infrastructure for Crusoe's AI factories
rows.detail: Facility secured by recently ordered power generation equipment; funds gas generators providing behind-the-meter power to Crusoe-built and Crusoe-owned AI factories. The release also restates the September 2026 close of a $3.9 billion Series F at a $30.9 billion post-money valuation. Amount as stated: $700 million.
